TZA.note: No rule or authority on AI harms stated.
The AI assistant sits inside the tax system, a sector system, not general administration.

facts.fact: Tanzania Revenue Authority's Shinyanga manager said on 27 January 2026 that the IDRAS domestic tax system is connected to AI so taxpayers can ask tax questions without visiting an office, with IDRAS due to start on 9 February 2026.

TZA.note: No AI model, dataset or computing built or hosted locally is stated.

facts.fact: Tanzania Revenue Authority trainers said on 27 January 2026 that the IDRAS integrated domestic tax system, due to start on 9 February 2026, lets a parent obtain a TIN for a child and requires existing TIN holders to reset passwords.
